title: Dual-luminescent Sc2(MoO4)3:Dy3+/Eu3+ phosphor system: energy transfer dynamics and high-sensitivity temperature sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28994-29002
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04860E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhengrong Xia, Rongqing Li, Fangfang Liu, Weiwei Zhou, Wang Zhao, Wei Meng, Mingjun Song, Junpeng Xue
Energy transfer from Dy3+ to Eu3+ was observed in the Sc2(MoO4)3 host and the distinct temperature-dependent luminescence behaviors of these ions were exploited for potential temperature sensing applications.
